This appendix forms part of the article and has not been edited by the journal. It is
referenced in the main text as "the appendix".

All results reported in this appendix are from the cohort-deduplicated (Set B)
analysis, in which one publication per cohort contributes to each outcome.

## S1. Search strategy

| Field | Content |
|:------|:--------|
| Databases searched | PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE (Elsevier), SCOPUS |
| Search dates | Database inception to **[FINAL SEARCH DATE — to be taken from the Covidence/RIS export log]** |
| Records retrieved | PubMed 1061; EMBASE 2603; SCOPUS 481 (total 4145) |
| Date limits applied | **[to be confirmed — sources conflict]** |
| Language limit | English |
| Publication types excluded via filter | None. Conference abstracts, editorials, letters, and case reports were excluded at screening rather than by search filter, to minimise inappropriate exclusion |
| Other sources searched | Reference list screening of included studies and prior systematic reviews; forward citation tracking (Web of Science) for key index publications; PROSPERO search for related and ongoing reviews |
| Deduplication and management | RIS export from each database, imported into Covidence for deduplication and screening |
| Search piloted against | Eight known included publications (Holtan 2022, Moiseev 2016, Tang 2023, Papanicolaou 2023, Salas 2023, Massoud 2021, Meyer 2024, Shaffer 2024) to verify recall |

: Search parameters. {#tbl-s1-parameters}

The protocol specifies three concept blocks combined with AND, each block an OR of
controlled vocabulary terms and free-text synonyms.

### PubMed/MEDLINE

```
#1  Allogeneic HCT population
    ("Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation"[Mesh] OR "Bone Marrow Transplantation"[Mesh]
     OR "allogeneic stem cell transplant*"[tiab] OR "allo-HCT"[tiab] OR "allo-HSCT"[tiab]
     OR "haploidentical"[tiab] OR "HLA-matched"[tiab] OR "matched unrelated donor"[tiab]
     OR "mismatched unrelated donor"[tiab])

#2  PTCy intervention
    ("post-transplant cyclophosphamide"[tiab] OR "post-transplantation cyclophosphamide"[tiab]
     OR "posttransplant cyclophosphamide"[tiab] OR "posttransplantation cyclophosphamide"[tiab]
     OR "PTCy"[tiab] OR "PT-Cy"[tiab] OR "PTCY"[tiab]
     OR ("Cyclophosphamide"[Mesh] AND "Graft vs Host Disease"[Mesh]))

#3  Infection outcomes
    ("Infections"[Mesh] OR "Bacterial Infections"[Mesh] OR "Virus Diseases"[Mesh]
     OR "Mycoses"[Mesh] OR "Bacteremia"[Mesh] OR "Sepsis"[Mesh]
     OR "Cytomegalovirus Infections"[Mesh] OR "Invasive Fungal Infections"[Mesh]
     OR "bacterial infection*"[tiab] OR "viral infection*"[tiab] OR "fungal infection*"[tiab]
     OR "BSI"[tiab] OR "sepsis"[tiab] OR "CMV"[tiab] OR "EBV"[tiab] OR "HHV-6"[tiab]
     OR "BK virus"[tiab] OR "aspergillosis"[tiab] OR "candida"[tiab] OR "mucormycosis"[tiab]
     OR "mold"[tiab] OR "yeast"[tiab] OR "mortality"[tiab])

#4  #1 AND #2 AND #3
    Filters: Humans; English
```

### EMBASE (Emtree)

```
#1  Allogeneic HCT population
    ('bone marrow transplantation'/exp OR 'stem cell transplantation'/exp
     OR 'allogeneic stem cell transplant*':ti,ab OR 'allo-hct':ti,ab OR 'allo-hsct':ti,ab
     OR haploidentical:ti,ab OR 'hla-matched':ti,ab OR 'matched unrelated donor':ti,ab
     OR 'mismatched unrelated donor':ti,ab)

#2  PTCy intervention
    ('post-transplant cyclophosphamide':ti,ab OR 'post-transplantation cyclophosphamide':ti,ab
     OR 'posttransplant cyclophosphamide':ti,ab OR 'posttransplantation cyclophosphamide':ti,ab
     OR ptcy:ti,ab OR 'pt-cy':ti,ab
     OR ('cyclophosphamide'/exp AND 'graft versus host reaction'/exp))

#3  Infection outcomes
    ('infection'/exp OR 'bacterial infection'/exp OR 'virus infection'/exp OR 'mycosis'/exp
     OR 'bacteremia'/exp OR 'sepsis'/exp OR 'cytomegalovirus infection'/exp
     OR 'invasive fungal infection'/exp
     OR 'bacterial infection*':ti,ab OR 'viral infection*':ti,ab OR 'fungal infection*':ti,ab
     OR bsi:ti,ab OR sepsis:ti,ab OR cmv:ti,ab OR ebv:ti,ab OR 'hhv-6':ti,ab
     OR 'bk virus':ti,ab OR aspergillosis:ti,ab OR candida:ti,ab OR mucormycosis:ti,ab
     OR mold:ti,ab OR yeast:ti,ab OR mortality:ti,ab)

#4  #1 AND #2 AND #3 AND [humans]/lim AND [english]/lim
```

### SCOPUS

```
TITLE-ABS-KEY(
  ("allogeneic stem cell transplant*" OR "allo-HCT" OR "allo-HSCT"
   OR "hematopoietic stem cell transplantation" OR "bone marrow transplantation"
   OR haploidentical OR "HLA-matched" OR "matched unrelated donor"
   OR "mismatched unrelated donor")
  AND
  ("post-transplant cyclophosphamide" OR "post-transplantation cyclophosphamide"
   OR "posttransplant cyclophosphamide" OR "posttransplantation cyclophosphamide"
   OR PTCy OR "PT-Cy" OR (cyclophosphamide AND "graft versus host disease"))
  AND
  (infection* OR "bacterial infection*" OR "viral infection*" OR "fungal infection*"
   OR BSI OR sepsis OR bacteremia OR CMV OR "cytomegalovirus infection*" OR EBV
   OR "HHV-6" OR "BK virus" OR aspergillosis OR candida OR mucormycosis OR mold
   OR yeast OR "invasive fungal infection*" OR mortality)
) AND LANGUAGE(english)
```

## S6. Model specification and priors

Primary model (M1), for study $s$, arm $i$:

$$
\text{events}_i \mid n_i \sim \text{Binomial}\!\left(n_i,\ \text{logit}^{-1}\!\left(\alpha + \beta_{\text{PTCy}} x_i + \beta_{\text{tp}} t_i + u_{s[i]}\right)\right),
\qquad u_s \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \tau^2)
$$

where $x_i$ indicates a PTCy arm and $t_i$ indicates a late (≥1 year) rather than early
(day +100 or +180) timepoint.

| Parameter | Prior |
|:----------|:------|
| Fixed effects (β) | N(0, 2·5) |
| Intercept (α) | N(0, 1·5) |
| Between-study SD (τ) | Student t(3, 0, 1), half |

: Prior specification for the primary model. {#tbl-s6-priors}

The steroid-mediation model (M2) adds arm-level systemic steroid exposure percentage,
mean-centred, as an additional fixed effect.

MCMC: four chains × 4000 iterations (1000 warmup), `adapt_delta` = 0·95, giving 12 000
post-warmup draws per model.

{{< pagebreak >}}

## S7. MCMC diagnostics

All Bayesian models were fitted with `brms` v2.23.0 and the `rstan` backend. R̂
(threshold < 1·01), bulk and tail effective sample size (ESS; threshold > 400), and the
number of divergent transitions are reported for every fitted model. Values are the
worst case (maximum R̂, minimum ESS) across all model parameters.

| Model | Max R̂ | Min bulk ESS | Min tail ESS | Divergences |
|:------|------:|-------------:|-------------:|------------:|
| OS M1 | 1·0037 | 1729 | 2962 | 0 |
| OS M2 | 1·0022 | 2645 | 4217 | 0 |
| NRM M1 | 1·0017 | 4176 | 5261 | 0 |
| NRM M2 | 1·0017 | 3061 | 4066 | 0 |
| aGVHD M1 | 1·0012 | 2178 | 3317 | 0 |
| CMV M1 | 1·0011 | 2814 | 4158 | 0 |
| CMV M2 | 1·0008 | 3323 | 4990 | 0 |
| BSI M1 | 1·0011 | 3643 | 5034 | 0 |
| IFI M1 | 1·0021 | 2795 | 4074 | 0 |
| RRM M1 | 1·0011 | 3161 | 3767 | 0 |
| BK M1 | 1·0013 | 3099 | 4143 | 0 |
| IRM M1 | 1·0010 | 2965 | 4257 | 0 |

: MCMC convergence diagnostics, comparison 1 models. {#tbl-s7a-i}

| Model | Max R̂ | Min bulk ESS | Min tail ESS | Divergences |
|:------|------:|-------------:|-------------:|------------:|
| OS M1 | 1·0030 | 3185 | 4841 | 0 |
| OS M2 | 1·0011 | 3714 | 5136 | 0 |
| NRM M1 | 1·0035 | 2876 | 2293 | 0 |
| aGVHD M1 | 1·0010 | 3191 | 4855 | 0 |
| CMV M1 | 1·0020 | 3436 | 5356 | 0 |
| CMV M2 | 1·0007 | 3321 | 5570 | 0 |
| RRM M1 | 1·0002 | 3225 | 4933 | 0 |
| BK M1 | 1·0592 | 67 | 17 | 0 |

: MCMC convergence diagnostics, comparison 2 models. {#tbl-s7a-ii}

All models except C2 BK achieved R̂ < 1·01 with zero divergent transitions and bulk ESS
above 1000. The C2 BK model (k = 3) did not converge to that standard (R̂ = 1·0592, bulk
ESS 67, tail ESS 17) and its posterior should be read as indicative only.

![Trace plots for `b_ptcy_binary` (top) and `sd_study_id__Intercept` (τ, bottom) in OS M1 (left) and CMV M1 (right). All four chains mix well across the full post-warmup phase.](figures/FigureS7b_trace_plots){#fig-s7b}

![Posterior densities of τ (between-study SD) for comparison 1 M1 models. The half-Student t(3, 0, 1) prior common to all models is shown in grey. IFI shows the widest τ posterior, consistent with the structural heterogeneity identified in the leave-one-out analysis (S9).](figures/FigureS7c_tau_posteriors){#fig-s7c}

![Posterior predictive checks, comparison 1. Each point is one study arm: the observed event proportion against its posterior predictive mean, over 500 posterior draws. The dashed line is the identity.](figures/FigureS7d_i_ppc_C1){#fig-s7d-i}

![Posterior predictive checks, comparison 2. Layout and interpretation as in @fig-s7d-i.](figures/FigureS7d_ii_ppc_C2){#fig-s7d-ii}

All models show adequate calibration, with points clustered near the identity line and
symmetric scatter. The C1 IFI model (k = 6) shows the widest scatter, consistent with
its large τ posterior (@fig-s7c) and the heterogeneity identified in S9. No systematic
over- or under-prediction is evident in any model.

## S9. Sensitivity analyses

![CMV sensitivity models, comparison 1: primary model, post-2020 restriction, and haploidentical-dominant restriction.](figures/FigureS9a_CMV_sensitivity){#fig-s9a}

![IFI leave-one-out analysis, comparison 1 (frequentist REML).](figures/FigureS9b_IFI_leave_one_out){#fig-s9b}

Full frequentist results for all models are provided in `freq_results_setB.csv`, a
supplementary data file, which carries the deduplicated fits where deduplication
applied and the original fits otherwise (see its `source` column). Direction was concordant between Bayesian and frequentist
estimates for every outcome. Two framework-specific differences are worth noting: C1 BSI
(Bayesian odds ratio 1·87 versus frequentist 1·29 [0·61–2·73]) and C1 IFI (0·43 versus
0·60 [0·21–1·74]), both reflecting the influence of informative priors at small k.

## S13. PROSPERO registration

The study protocol was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261372156) before data
extraction. Protocol amendments were: (1) a Bayesian rather than frequentist primary
analysis framework; (2) addition of BK virus reactivation, infection-related mortality,
and relapse-related mortality as secondary outcomes; and (3) addition of the
steroid-mediation (M2) model.
